courses.title: Hockey fundamentals
courses.description: The rink, the words, and who does what when the puck is in our end. For every position.

modules.title: The rink
modules.description: The places and the words the lessons use, found by tapping them on the rink.

modules.title: In our zone
modules.description: What they want when they have the puck in our end, and who covers what.

modules.title: Out of our zone
modules.description: How the puck gets out once we win it, and how they try to stop it.

courses.title: Winger
courses.description: Where a winger stands and what they watch, drawn from the right wing. Builds on Hockey fundamentals.

modules.title: D-zone
modules.description: Where to be in our own zone while they have the puck.

modules.title: Breakouts
modules.description: Where to be when we win the puck and carry it out.
